name: Elminage: Yami no Miko to Kamigami no Yubiwa
summary: In a fantasy world protected by six divine rings, priestesses seeking the Demon King’s return break the barrier and scatter five of the rings, allowing monsters to spread across the land. The player creates a party of up to six adventurers and explores first-person, grid-based dungeons to recover the rings, complete quests, develop characters across multiple races and classes, and collect equipment.
